notes: Corpus bootstrap (knowledge distillation): a capable model works HELD-OUT tasks; rag_scrape_journal.py keeps only solver-certified iterations as exemplars.

Held out from the of-record experiment by construction: different networks (case118, case_ACTIVSg500, case9mod) and different goal instances. The scraper additionally drops anything from grader_ablation_spec.json networks/goals.
Condition C0-norag only, so the corpus is not built from its own retrievals.

Model: the eval set also uses claude-sonnet-4-6. Generating with the same model makes the strong-model arm mildly circular; the weak/mid arms are unaffected. Record the choice in the paper, or switch 'model' to a model outside the eval set.

PFLOW goals (overload relief / voltage support) need a stressed variant of each held-out case: run rag/tools/precheck_cases.py --case <case> --apps pflow [--vband 0.95,1.05], freeze with --write-stressed, then add a pflow case entry pointing at the frozen file.
Run from the agentigrid project root: python rag/tools/experiment_runner.py --spec rag/tools/specs/corpus_bootstrap_spec.json

goals.text: Lower the total generation cost by at least 5% while staying feasible
Keep every bus voltage between 0.97 and 1.03 pu at the lowest cost you can find
Take the largest generator out of service and restore a feasible, low-cost operating point
Determine how much uniform load growth the system tolerates while remaining feasible, testing growth in steps
Obtain a dispatch that stays feasible for every contingency in the contingency file and report its cost
Obtain a contingency-secure dispatch with all bus voltages held between 0.96 and 1.04 pu
